Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIX
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE
XXXIX OF 1999
An Ordinance further to amend the
Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 28th July, 1999]
No. Legis.-3(XXXIX)/99, dated
28-7-1999.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.-- (1) This Ordinance may be called the Lahore Development
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the day the Lahore Development
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999 (XVIII of 1999) stands repealed under
Article 128(2) of the Constitution.

Addition of section 11-A and 11-B in Act XXX of 1975

ORDINANCE XXXIX
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE
XXXIX OF 1999
An Ordinance further to amend the
Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 28th July, 1999]
No. Legis.-3(XXXIX)/99, dated
28-7-1999.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information:---
2. Addition of sections 11-A
and 11-B. in Act XXX of 1975.--In the Lahore Development Authority Act,
1975 (XXX of 1975) hereinafter referred to as the said Act, after section 11
the following new sections shall be added:--
"11-A.
Notwithstanding anything contained in section 11 or any rules or regulations
made or orders or instructions issued thereunder or contained in the terms and
conditions of service of any person employed or serving under the Authority or
an Agency the Authority may at any time retire or remove from service any
person after informing him in writing of the grounds on which such action is
proposed to be taken and giving him an opportunity of showing cause in writing
against the action within a period of 14 days.
11-B. Liability
for loss.--Any person employed by or serving under the Authority or an Agency
charged with the administration of the affairs of the Authority or an Agency or
acting on behalf of the Authority or an Agency or acting under a contract with
the Authority or an Agency who is responsible for the loss, waste,
misappropriation or misapplication of any money or property belonging to the
Authority or an Agency which is a direct consequence of his negligence or
misconduct in the discharge of his duties shall be liable to pay the loss
suffered by the Authority or an Agency on the same being determined by the
Authority after giving the person concerned a reasonable opportunity of being
heard."
sections.punishment:
shall be liable to pay the loss
suffered by the Authority or an Agency on the same being determined by the
Authority after giving the person concerned a reasonable opportunity of being
heard.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 34 of Act XXX of 1975

ORDINANCE XXXIX
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE
XXXIX OF 1999
An Ordinance further to amend the
Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 28th July, 1999]
No. Legis.-3(XXXIX)/99, dated
28-7-1999.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information:---
3. Amendment of section 34 of
Act XXX of 1975.--In the said Act in section 34, the following subsection
(4-A) shall be added:--
"(4-A) Whoever negligently
does any act in the performance of his duties which causes loss of money or
property to the Authority or an Agency, shall be liable to be punished with
imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years."
sections.punishment:
shall be liable to be punished with
imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years.
